scope: Independent saved-evidence audit; no fits, network, production imports or configuration writes.

limitations: One dataset/model seed for rotating-factor cases; not twelve independent families.
No per-case input hashes or raw truth/prediction arrays in the classification study; arithmetic/selection verified, not raw metric recomputation.
Exhaustive offline scores are not budgeted selector deployment evidence; repeats store verdicts rather than complete second-run evidence.
Six related synthetic mechanisms, not ninety independent datasets.
Fixed policy execution order and metric bookkeeping prevent causal speed claims.
Feature-dependent masks do not establish safety under genuinely label-informative missingness.
Direct calls cannot certify full CLI deadlines or eight-family P0 promotion criteria.

objective_policy.meaning: No official points estimated; metric scenarios express uncertainty, not protected objectives.

ranked_advice.action: Separate class-weight policy from estimator selection; score the same fitted candidates under all scenarios and inspect class recall.
ranked_advice.experiment: Change one factor; pair frozen candidates on identical inputs; reserve unopened families for confirmation.
ranked_advice.acceptance: Improve official score when available, otherwise improve robust scenario ranking with family-level uncertainty; no metric-specific zero-loss veto.

ranked_advice.action: Measure checkpoint-first overhead and recovery quality at 10/25/50-second budgets before changing safeguards.

required: Verified incumbent and immutable baseline comparison

limitations: Historical predictions, macro F1, MAE, AMI and class recalls cannot be reconstructed unless supplied.
No expected total score can be calculated without official formulas or defensible dataset-distribution weights.
Rank regret ignores effect magnitude; worst-case deltas and severe-regression review remain essential.
Missing scenarios and fewer than eight family groups preclude promotion; historical confirmation labels do not prove freshness.
No case manifest means entirely omitted families cannot be detected.

measured_accuracy_gate.scope: Observed paired cases only; any single measured ordinary-accuracy loss rejects, even if the mean improves.
